title: Allows users to configure types which should not be held across await suspension points.
summary: There are some types which are perfectly safe to use concurrently from a memory access perspective, but that will cause bugs at runtime if they are held in such a way. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for calls to await while holding a non-async-aware MutexGuard.
summary: The Mutex types found in std::sync and parking_lot are not designed to operate in an async context across await points. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for calls to await while holding a RefCell, Ref, or RefMut.
summary: RefCell refs only check for exclusive mutable access at runtime. Holding a RefCell ref across an await suspension point risks panics from a mutable ref shared while other refs are outstanding. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.
